factory.description: The Factory screens: the 라인 with 결정 필요 on top (PRD factory-human-loop), the graph and the Task page, beside the shell's sidebar with the Factory row and the 비서 row.

states.line: 라인 at rest: 결정 필요 on top with its items open, one row per Task beneath, the person's turn in the warning band, 후속 후보 folded at the foot.
states.board: 보드: four lanes by movement, 시작 전 · 진행 중 · 멈춤 (나를 기다림, 다른 걸 기다림) · 완료, with the narrow lanes drawing their cards small and old completions folded.
states.graph: 그래프: layered Tasks with arrows, none for a dependency a longer path implies, and the unrelated Tasks below.
states.task: Task page of the verifying Task: the state sentence, the track with who decided where, summary, the criteria checklist, decisions split 나 / AI with one 다른 답 open, the activity timeline, the original issue and its 후속 후보.

judgment: The 라인 and Task page frames are the approved design of PRD factory-human-loop with no reference picture: do spacing, weight, color and alignment carry the same intent as the Pen frame? The graph keeps its reference picture e3.
The Dark frames are set against the Light ones. Does Dark use the tokens as the Light does, with the same hierarchy?
Does each 결정 필요 item read as one decision: the sentence, what stopped, the choices with their results and 추천, 다른 답, the default line, and the folded 근거?
Is the warning band on the person's rows the only colour that says whose turn it is, on the 라인, the board and the graph?
Long Korean titles and the long issue number: is a title still recognizable where the row cuts it, and does nothing overlap?

factory-board.description: The Factory board by movement and the one card at three sizes (PRD factory-board-cards): the board window, the graph with small cards, and every kind of card at the small, normal and wide widths.

states.board: 보드: four lanes by movement, 시작 전 · 진행 중 · 멈춤 (나를 기다림, 다른 걸 기다림) · 완료, with the narrow lanes drawing their cards small and old completions folded.
states.graph: 그래프: layered Tasks as small cards with arrows, none for a dependency a longer path implies, and the unrelated Tasks below.
states.sizes: 같은 카드, 세 크기: every kind of card (답 필요, 머지 대기, 멈춤, 실행 중, 하위 에이전트, 검증 중, 쉬는 중, 밖에서 진행, 시작 전, 완료) at 210, 300 and 470 px.

judgment: Does the eye land on the title, the one colored state icon, the problem line and the left band first, with everything else small and gray?

Does each size drop the less important parts first: small keeps the numbers, logo, icon and a two-line title; normal adds the summary, bar, problem and one button; wide adds the second summary line, the state word with the worker mark, the other buttons and the ✦ line?
Is 멈춤 the one lane to look at, with 나를 기다림 above 다른 걸 기다림, and do the narrow 시작 전 and 완료 lanes read as quiet?
Does the hatched current cell read as stopped at that stage without a word, in Light and Dark?
Long Korean titles and long English identifiers: does each size cut them at its line count without overlap, breaking Korean between words rather than inside one?

core-move-devices.description: Settings > Devices with the core's badge and the move's entry, and the move dialog over Settings in its five forms (PRD core-host-node-move B2 to B5, D-06; the operator's flow B).

states.devices: This Mac runs the core: its row wears the core badge, Mac mini and build-box are SSH devices this core dials.
states.devices-menu: Mac mini's ⋯ menu open with core를 이 기기로 옮기기… between the helper items and 제거….
states.devices-offline: build-box is not connected: its ⋯ menu shows the move entry dimmed with 연결 안 됨.
states.node-menu: The core runs on Mac mini and this window is the MacBook's: this Mac's ⋯ menu offers 연결 정보…, core를 이 Mac으로 되돌리기… and Mac mini core와 연결 끊기…, and Mac mini's row wears the badge with its hint.

states.moving: The five steps with the current one running.

states.done: Moved: the phone's QR line and 되돌리기.

judgment: Is the core badge on This Mac quiet beside the name, and does the move's entry sit in the ⋯ menu where the bundle puts it?

The Dark frames are set against the Light ones: does Dark use the tokens as Light does?

core-move-window.description: A window whose core runs on another machine: the rail with the core machine's crown (N1) and the strip that names the move, the core's update, an unreachable core and a link the operator ended (PRD core-host-node-move B2, W1 to W3, B10, B16).

states.rail-core: Mac mini's own window: This Mac first wearing the crown, then the MacBook that dials in.
states.window-moving: W1: the strip names the move's step of five while the window takes no input.
states.window-updating: W2: the strip says the core is being updated to this app's build and agents keep running.
states.window-unreachable: W3: the strip says the core cannot be reached and the window reconnects.
states.window-disconnected: B16, drawn by analogy with W3 (not in the approved bundle): the operator ended the link here and the strip offers 다시 연결.

judgment: Is the crown readable at 9 px in the tile's bottom-left notch without fighting the Needs You mark or the ×?
Does each strip state read in one line in the badge's place, with … for waiting and ! for a problem?
The disconnected strip has no approved frame: does it read as the same family as W3, with 다시 연결 as the only action?
